key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between usage fetches. Provider endpoints behind subscription plans rate-limit hard; the extension serves its cache between fetches.

key.name: show-bar-text
key.description: Show the usage percentage next to the icon in the top bar. When off, the pin setting has no effect.

key.name: show-account-email
key.description: Show the account email/label under each provider card. When off, only the plan is shown.

key.name: show-decimals
key.description: Whole numbers render without decimals; anything else keeps one decimal place. When off, everything rounds to whole numbers.

key.name: pinned-provider
key.description: Pin one entry to the top bar: a provider id (codex) or provider/account (codex/work). Empty means the overall percentage.

key.name: bar-windows
key.description: Which usage windows compose the bar text and the pinned headline: primary (Session), secondary (Weekly), tertiary (Monthly).

key.name: provider-order
key.description: Ordered provider ids (or provider/account keys). Empty means the CLI order.

key.name: theme-mode
key.description: One of system, light, dark, builtin, custom. System follows the GNOME color-scheme preference.

key.name: theme-builtin
key.description: One of macos-dark, macos-light, nord, dracula, tokyo-night.

key.name: theme-opacity
key.description: Popup background opacity. Only the background fill fades; text and bars stay fully opaque.

key.name: theme-custom
key.description: JSON object with custom colors: background, text, subtext, accent, warning, critical, track, border.

key.name: bar-height
key.description: Usage progress bar height in pixels.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Popup card corner radius in pixels.
